arguments.description: Check coord for S1943 and ledger tail
arguments.command: Select-String -Path coord\*.md -Pattern 'S1943|S1911' | Select-Object -First 10 | ForEach-Object { $_.Path + ':' + $_.LineNumber + ': ' + $_.Line }; Write-Output '---ledger tail---'; Get-Content AUDIT_LEDGER.md -Tail 12
